newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX SCORE THREE, FEYENOORD BACK ON TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX SCORE THREE, FEYENOORD BACK ON TOP.

text.p: Struggling Ajax Amsterdam recovered from their recent goal drought by scoring three in 10 minutes against bottom-of-the-table Willem II Tilburg on Wednesday.

Arnold Scholten in the 18th, Tijjani Babangida in the 23rd and Kiki Musampa in the 28th minute gave Ajax a 3-0 victory and lifted them to sixth place overall, still seven points behind leaders Feyenoord.
The Rotterdam side were keen to regain the top spot they relinquished briefly to PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday and did so by beating lowly Groningen 3-1.
With 22 points from nine games, Feyenoord are now two points clear of PSV.

Ajax, who had only scored six goals in eight previous league matches, welcomed back defender John Veldman and midfielder Richard Witschge from injury and showed signs of the football their fans have grown accustomed to in past seasons.
Feyenoord, though, continued to impress after Ronald Koeman had opened the scoring in the 13th minute from the penalty spot.

Groningen drew level in the 50th minute with a solo effort from Brazilian striker Magno, but their hopes were dashed when Gaston Taument headed home and Pable Sanchez struck a shot over Groningen goalkeeper Patrick Lodewijks.
Groningen finished the match with 10 men after defender Jan Veenhof was sent off in the 73rd minute for receiving a second yellow card.
